description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

scenarios.scenario: A product marketer at Anthropic is building an external presentation in HTML/CSS and needs the exact corporate hex codes and font pairings.
scenarios.user_query: Can you give me Anthropic's official color palette and typography rules? I need the exact hex values and font families for headings and body text so I can style our landing page mockup.

scenarios.scenario: A front-end developer is creating a dashboard component and needs to ensure the UI matches Anthropic's brand aesthetics.
scenarios.user_query: I'm styling a dashboard widget for an internal demo. What are our primary dark and light background colors, plus the secondary accent colors according to our brand guidelines?

scenarios.scenario: A graphic designer is preparing a visual infographic and wants to style three distinct feature cards using official brand accents.
scenarios.user_query: I need three distinct accent colors that follow Anthropic brand identity to color-code three comparison cards in my infographic.

scenarios.scenario: A developer is writing a Python script using python-pptx to generate slides and wants the slide theme to adhere strictly to Anthropic's visual guidelines.
scenarios.user_query: I am generating a PowerPoint presentation using python-pptx. Can you provide the RGBColor specifications and font hierarchy for Anthropic branded decks?

scenarios.scenario: A developer building a documentation theme needs CSS variables configured with Anthropic's exact typography and color palette.
scenarios.user_query: Generate a CSS root variables stylesheet using Anthropic's brand guidelines, including heading/body fonts with fallbacks and all primary and accent hex codes.

scenarios.scenario: A research engineer is putting together a research paper summary PDF and wants it to look like an official Anthropic publication.
scenarios.user_query: I'm compiling a PDF summary of our latest model findings. Make sure it follows Anthropic's corporate identity standards for typography and text colors.

scenarios.scenario: A marketing specialist is creating an email newsletter template and needs to align the text styling with company branding.
scenarios.user_query: What font families and fallbacks should I specify in my HTML email template to conform to Anthropic brand styling for headers versus paragraph text?

scenarios.scenario: A designer is setting up a Tailwind CSS config for an Anthropic web application.
scenarios.user_query: Please generate a tailwind.config.js theme extension that incorporates Anthropic's official brand colors (dark, light, grays, orange, blue, green) and font pairings (Poppins/Lora).

scenarios.scenario: A technical writer is styling an SVG architecture diagram to match Anthropic's company brand standards.
scenarios.user_query: I have an SVG diagram with several node boxes. Which Anthropic brand accent colors should I use for highlight strokes and badges?

scenarios.scenario: An event coordinator is ordering stage backdrop assets and needs the precise color codes approved by Anthropic brand management.
scenarios.user_query: I'm submitting color specs to the print vendor for conference banners. Please list the exact hex codes for Anthropic's main dark, light, mid gray, light gray, and primary orange accent.

scenarios.scenario: A UX designer is setting up a design token JSON file for Anthropic's design system.
scenarios.user_query: Can you generate a design-tokens.json file documenting Anthropic's visual identity palette (main and accent colors) along with font families and fallback definitions?

scenarios.scenario: A developer is generating a customer-facing report in Matplotlib and wants the chart styling to reflect Anthropic corporate colors.
scenarios.user_query: How do I configure Matplotlib rcParams to use Anthropic's official brand colors (#141413, #faf9f5, accents #d97757, #6a9bcc, #788c5d) and Poppins font?

scenarios.scenario: A communications lead is reviewing a draft slide deck and wants to ensure all headers and body fonts follow company guidelines.
scenarios.user_query: Can you check the typography rules in Anthropic brand guidelines? What font is mandated for headings over 24pt and what should be used for body text?

scenarios.scenario: A web designer is creating a dark-mode banner and needs to know the correct background and foreground color pairings from Anthropic's style guide.
scenarios.user_query: What are Anthropic's designated dark and light color codes for high-contrast dark-themed visual assets?

scenarios.scenario: A product team member is building an interactive demo site and wants to confirm the tertiary accent color in the Anthropic design system.
scenarios.user_query: What is the official tertiary accent color in the Anthropic brand identity, and what hex code should I use for success badges?

scenarios.scenario: A developer has built a barebones HTML table comparing model benchmarks and wants it styled to look like an official company asset.
scenarios.user_query: Here's my raw HTML table of benchmark scores. Can you style it so it looks clean, elegant, and perfectly on-brand for Anthropic?

scenarios.scenario: A product manager is preparing an investor update slide and needs the raw text formatted with company-appropriate visual hierarchy and aesthetics.
scenarios.user_query: I drafted this 3-bullet executive summary for leadership. Please format it with our company's standard look-and-feel, typography, and accent highlights.

scenarios.scenario: A data scientist generated a seaborn chart for an external blog post and wants the visual theme customized to match company style.
scenarios.user_query: I have this seaborn bar plot comparing inference latency across models. Could you restyle the palette and typography so it fits seamlessly into our public corporate blog?

scenarios.scenario: A sales engineer is drafting a one-page technical solution overview in Markdown/HTML for an enterprise client.
scenarios.user_query: Turn this raw markdown pitch into a polished one-page HTML document that matches the official visual styling and color scheme of our company.

scenarios.scenario: A developer is writing a script that outputs automated weekly metric reports as styled HTML emails.
scenarios.user_query: I need inline CSS for our automated alert emails. They should look completely native to our company identity with warm dark text, clean background, and subtle accent pills.

scenarios.scenario: A technical writer created an API reference cheat sheet and wants to apply corporate color accents to method badges (GET, POST, DELETE).
scenarios.user_query: I'm making an API reference card. Can you give me three harmonized brand accent colors to differentiate GET, POST, and DELETE endpoints?

scenarios.scenario: An AI researcher is designing a poster for an academic conference and wants to ensure the typography matches the company's public identity.
scenarios.user_query: I am laying out a research poster in Typst. What font pairings should I use for titles versus paragraph text to maintain our organization's signature visual style?

scenarios.scenario: A founder at an Anthropic-partnered startup is designing a co-branded deck and wants the Anthropic section to match its authentic aesthetic.
scenarios.user_query: I'm building a co-marketing slide deck and want the Anthropic overview slides to match Anthropic's distinct aesthetic. What colors and font combinations should I apply?

scenarios.scenario: A developer is creating a CLI tool that outputs rich terminal text and wants the ANSI color formatting inspired by company styling.
scenarios.user_query: I'm styling the terminal output of our internal CLI tool using Rich. What color palette should I set for primary text, subtle borders, and warning/info accents to match our organization's visual design?

scenarios.scenario: A documentation lead is revamping the corporate developer portal layout with proper card background tones.
scenarios.user_query: We are refreshing the doc site's callout boxes. What hex values should we use for subtle background panels and secondary text elements to align with our visual standards?

scenarios.scenario: A team lead is creating a printable certificate of completion for an internal prompt engineering course.
scenarios.user_query: Please design an HTML/CSS layout for an award certificate that reflects our company's sophisticated, warm minimalist visual identity.

scenarios.scenario: A product manager needs to create a visual roadmap timeline graphic with alternating milestone colors.
scenarios.user_query: I'm rendering a SVG milestone timeline for Q3. Can you give me the sequence of three accent colors from our company design standards to cycle through the milestone nodes?

scenarios.scenario: An operations lead is formatting an internal policy handbook in Pandoc and wants appropriate typography settings.
scenarios.user_query: I'm converting our onboarding guide from Markdown to PDF via Weasyprint. Which heading and body font families should I declare so it reflects our corporate look?

scenarios.scenario: A marketing intern is creating a social media quote card graphic and needs the right dark background tone and accent highlight.
scenarios.user_query: I'm designing a quote card for Twitter featuring a quote from Dario. What dark color should I use for the card background, and what accent color for the quotation mark icon?

scenarios.scenario: A customer success manager is formatting a quarterly business review document in Google Docs / Word.
scenarios.user_query: I want to manually set up custom styles in my QBR doc. What exact font names should I assign to Title/Heading 1 and Normal text so it matches our company's aesthetic?
